title: Herbal Thai Chicken Skewers
description: Rich and snappy Thai dish featuring lime juice and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine lemongrass, galangal, lime juice, coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Place the chicken pieces in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them, tossing to coat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or basil.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
